children.text:
SAAM - Document Analysis - Produce Usage Report step
==========

The "SAAM - Document Analysis - Produce Usage Report" custom steps enables an easy integration with the SAS Document Analysis (SDA) model, to create output reports on executed runs.

The location of the generated output will be displayed for after running this step.

This step can be run after you executed a batch OCR process, for example by using the SAAM - Document Analysis - Execute Batch OCR Process custom step.

A license for SAS Document Analysis (SDA) is required and you will need to know the name of the launcher context that was created during the deployment of SDA.

Pre-requisites:  Tested on Viya version Stable 2024.08 & Stable 2026.01

* Version 1.7 (23JUN2026)
     - Added "OCR Usage" report type option (create_ocr_usage_report.py)

* Version 1.6 (28MAY2026)
     - Renamed step from "OCR - Document Analysis - Produce Usage Report Output" to "SAAM - Document Analysis - Produce Usage Report" to conform to the SAAM naming standard

* Version 1.5 (22APR2026)
     - Remove "bypass SSL" option. Default to False

* Version 1.4 (16APR2026)
     - Communicate exit codes for failed SDA batch processes

* Version 1.3 (19FEB2026)
     - Use absolute path for python command

* Version 1.2 (25FEB2025)
 - Use launcher context name instead ID
